summary: Iteration 175 - Concierge Inbox Admin Panel tested. All 4 backend admin endpoints working correctly (sessions list, session detail, flag, unflag). Frontend panel loads with stats cards, sessions list, thread view, flag/unflag buttons all functional. Dialog prompt for flag reason works. Flagged filter works. Regression tests passed for AI Concierge widget on booking page and RM Lab navigation.

integration_issues.issue: Known issue from iter 173/174: Playwright's fill()/type() doesn't properly trigger React's controlled input onChange/onBlur for loyalty check. Backend API works correctly (verified via curl).
integration_issues.workaround: Use page.evaluate with nativeInputValueSetter to set value and dispatch 'input' event
integration_issues.priority: LOW - UI works correctly for real users, only affects automated testing

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/concierge/admin/{property_id}/sessions - returns sessions list with stats - VERIFIED
Response includes: sessions[], total_sessions, total_messages, flagged_messages - VERIFIED
Each session has: session_id, first_at, last_at, last_role, last_preview, messages, flagged - VERIFIED
GET /api/concierge/admin/{property_id}/session/{session_id} - returns full message list - VERIFIED
POST /api/concierge/admin/messages/{message_id}/flag - sets flagged=true, stores reason - VERIFIED
Both flag/unflag return 404 for unknown message_id - VERIFIED
Stats cards show sessions/messages/flagged counts - VERIFIED
Sessions list (data-testid='ci-sessions') populated with session previews - VERIFIED
Flag button (data-testid='ci-flag-{msgid}') shows prompt dialog for reason - VERIFIED
After flagging: message highlights, 'Clear flag' button appears, flagged count updates - VERIFIED
Clear flag button (data-testid='ci-unflag-{msgid}') removes flag - VERIFIED
Flagged only filter (data-testid='ci-filter-flagged') filters sessions list - VERIFIED
